Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Holds a row as logical replication carries it, for [PgRelationWriter](/api/ankus.pgrelationwriter/): each column's value in
PostgreSQL's text or binary form, SQL NULL, or not sent.

```csharp
public sealed class PgReplicatedRow
```

<p>
The writer converts each value with its column type's input or receive function, as the built-in apply worker
does, so the values need no managed type. A column that is not sent takes its default in an insert and keeps its
current value in an update, as an unchanged TOAST value does.
</p>
<p>
Columns are numbered from zero as in the writer's [Descriptor](/api/ankus.pgrelationwriter/#member-73d13a827c335765), including dropped
columns, which must stay unsent or NULL. Text received from a [PgReplicationConnection](/api/ankus.pgreplicationconnection/) is already in
the database's encoding and can be passed as bytes; text from a string is converted. Setting a column again
replaces its value, and [Clear()](/api/ankus.pgreplicatedrow/#member-5f64cf81dc4f300c) makes the row reusable.
</p>

Inheritance: [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)
